subject: Data Engineering
title: Additive, Semi-Additive, and Non-Additive Facts
description: A quick win: understand Additive, Semi-Additive, and Non-Additive Facts.

hook.text: You can sum daily revenue to get monthly revenue. But can you sum daily bank balances? No.

buildup.text: Additive facts like revenue can be summed across all dimensions. They're the easiest to work with.

discovery.text: Semi-additive facts like account balances can be summed across some dimensions but not time.

twist.text: Non-additive facts like unit price or temperature can't be meaningfully summed at all.

climax.text: Knowing a fact's additivity prevents bogus calculations that look correct but aren't.

punchline.text: Not every number should be summed. Know which ones.

quiz.question: Why can't you sum bank account balances across time?
options: Balances are semi-additive and only valid at a point in time
